retrieve_class_names_dataset: retrieve the class names list for a specific dataset from CLASS_NAMES dictionary
lookup_dataset_labels: lookup the label names for a given dataset key like flowers or imagenet1k
get_language_class_names: get all dataset class names available under a language key like en
count_dataset_classes: count the number of class labels in a dataset like caltech101 or fer2013
verify_dataset_exists: verify whether a dataset key exists in the CLASS_NAMES mapping
